noah: Quick release-train note  short quiet-window tomorrow 2026-05-03 13:00-14:30 UTC. Please skim and call out blockers.

noah: TL;DR:
- Quiet window 13:00-14:30 UTC (no schema or major migrations).
- Change: canary defaults for infra patches set to 10% for 15m, auto-revert on health-gate fail.
- Health gates: 5xx <= 0.2% over 5m, p99 <= +15% vs baseline, error-budget burn < 25%.

angela: New default is fine for small infra fixes. For model rollouts owners must opt into extended canary.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: maintenance window created: 2026-05-03T13:00:00Z - 2026-05-03T14:30:00Z  id: mw-2179998888

infra-oncall: I will monitor p99 and 5xx; will post markers at start, 15m-check, 45m-check.

noah: Rollback quick commands:
- `rctl canary set --service=$SERVICE --percent=0`
- `kubectl rollout undo deployment/$DEP -n $NS`
If automation doesn't trigger, ping @release-czar or @infra-oncall.

release-czar: Adding a short blurb to the weekly changelog and will send a T-3h org reminder.

angela: Also, Dedicated tenants unaffected by the default; opt-in instructions remain the same.

noah: Thanks all. Keep this thread for live updates during the window. If you see anything odd DM me. :eyes:
